note: Written before the checks were run. Standard numbers and rules come from Ticket-04 (docs/spec/phase-4.md). Items carried over from Phases 2 and 3 keep their ids. A not-met row stays not met until the file or recording exists.

requirements.requirement: Movement: full speed 6 m/s within 0.1 s, jump 7 m/s with gravity 20 only from the ground.
requirements.how: accel 60 ticks (z = 5.75 m) and jump scenario: peak 1.167 m, landing after 41 ticks.

requirements.requirement: Dash: 14 m/s for 12 ticks, cooldown 1.5 s from its start, direction of movement or facing, event dash.
requirements.how: dash scenario with presses at ticks 0, 89 (refused) and 91: events at ticks 1 and 92.

requirements.requirement: Fireflies: capacity 10; picked when XZ <= 1.0 m and height difference <= 1.5 m; picking gives no points.
requirements.how: pickup_height and capacity scenarios.

requirements.requirement: Lanterns: first lighting costs 10 fireflies, several deposits, nearest acceptable lantern within 2.0 m; +5 per firefly, +100 per first lighting.
requirements.how: deposit scenarios (full: 10 x 5 + 100 = 150, partial, top-up, 2.1 m away).

requirements.requirement: Falling below Y = -10: once, -1 flame, all fireflies lost, wait 60 ticks, respawn at the start with 90 ticks of invulnerability.
requirements.how: fall scenario with 4 fireflies carried, event and snapshots around the respawn.

requirements.requirement: Shade hit: -1 flame, drop floor(carried/2) fireflies 1.5-2.5 m away (480 ticks), invulnerability 90 ticks, recoil 60 ticks; last flame loses at once.
requirements.how: shade_hit (hits at ticks 1, 91, 181) and lose_flames.

requirements.requirement: Pulse: 3 fireflies, 5 m (3D from feet + 0.8), stun 120 ticks, push 4 m in 15 ticks, +5 per shade, cooldown 3 s, nothing without enough light.
requirements.how: pulse, pulse_cooldown, pulse_no_light scenarios.

requirements.requirement: Safe zone: lit lanterns keep shades out of 6 m; shades inside when the lantern is lit are pushed out within 30 ticks without damage.
requirements.how: safe_zone and lit_pushout scenarios.

requirements.requirement: Shades: 2 spawn at tick 300 then every 480 ticks on the r=37 ring, state spawning for 60 ticks, detection 12 m.
requirements.how: shade_random and shade_detect scenarios.

requirements.requirement: Fireflies: 20 at distinct standard points at the start, one more at ticks 240, 480... while below 30.
requirements.how: mote_spawn scenario.

requirements.requirement: Pause: events paused/resumed, state paused, tick counts but sim_tick, time and positions stand still.
requirements.how: pause scenario.

requirements.requirement: Night 2 (two islands and a bridge): 6 lanterns, 270 s, bridge walkable, no floor beside it.
requirements.how: night2_bridge, night2_off_bridge, random_night2.

requirements.requirement: Bounce pads: night 2 (14 m/s up, 24 m/s toward the other island, about 1.4 s) and night 3 (12 up, 8 m/s toward -Z onto floor 2); velocity locked in the air.
requirements.how: night2_pad, night3_pad scenarios.

requirements.requirement: Charm (Bua Gio): picked like a firefly, 600 ticks of 7.2 m/s and dash without cooldown, back after 2700 ticks.
requirements.how: night2_charm scenario.

requirements.requirement: Night 3 (three floors): 7 lanterns, 300 s, cliffs stop Mây, ramps lead to floor 1, off the inner edge she drops back.
requirements.how: night3_cliff, night3_ramp, random_night3.

requirements.requirement: Strong wind in night 3: gust of 5 s every 30 s pushing 2 m/s in one direction.
requirements.how: night3_wind scenario: gust window 1800..2099 and 10 m of drift.

requirements.requirement: Drifters (Gio Lac): idle -> chase (carrying >= 5 within 15 m), touch steals min(3, carried) once, flees; pulse makes it flee or drop the loot.
requirements.how: drifter_steal, drifter_pulse scenarios.

requirements.requirement: Determinism: same seed + scenario + inputs = identical bytes in all three nights.
requirements.how: Every scenario is run twice and compared byte for byte.

requirements.requirement: Output: snapshot fields of v1.2 are still all there, 3 decimals, ticks never go backwards, end line last.
requirements.how: Structural assertions over every scenario output.

requirements.requirement: Exit codes: 0 ok (nights 1-3), 2 malformed inputs/scenario, non-zero with a message otherwise (including --night 4).
requirements.how: Calls to the CLI with good and bad arguments.

requirements.requirement: A full night (14,400 / 16,200 / 18,000 ticks) runs headless in 30 s or less.
requirements.how: full_night1/2/3, wall time measured by the script (machine dependent).

requirements.requirement: Unit tests pass.
requirements.how: vitest, counts from its JSON report.

requirements.requirement: game.contract.json is v1.3 (adds bench_cmd and soak_cmd; run_cmd takes --export-leaderboard) and its tuning equals src/sim/tuning.ts.
requirements.how: contract tests in tests/io.test.ts plus header fields.

requirements.requirement: Lantern fuel: a lit lantern has 100 fuel and loses 1 per second; at 0 it goes off (event lantern_out), forgets its fireflies but remembers it was lit.
requirements.how: fuel_decay and lantern_out scenarios: fuel 99 at tick 60, 90 at tick 600, lantern_out at tick 120.

requirements.requirement: Refuel: a lit lantern that is not full takes min(carried, ceil((100 - fuel)/10)) fireflies, +10 fuel each, +5 points each, event refuel; nothing carried = nothing happens.
requirements.how: refuel, refuel_small, refuel_no_light scenarios.

requirements.requirement: Relight: a lantern that was lit before needs 5 fireflies, +5 each and +40; relight:true in lantern_lit; fuel 100.
requirements.how: relight and relight_partial scenarios.

requirements.requirement: Drain: shades walk to a weak lit lantern (fuel < 30), stop within 2 m and drain 5 fuel/s each; event fuel_drain every 60 ticks; chase when Mây is within 6 m; a pulse on a draining shade scores 15.
requirements.how: drain, drain_two_shades, drain_chase, drain_pulse scenarios.

requirements.requirement: Safe zone only with fuel >= 30: a weak lantern does not keep shades out; refuelling to 30+ pushes them out harmlessly; wandering shades pick a weak lantern first.
requirements.how: weak_unsafe (29), strong_safe (31), refuel_pushout, wander_to_weak scenarios.

requirements.requirement: Capacity 10 + 2 per successful lighting, at most 20.
requirements.how: capacity_growth, capacity_cap, light_grows_capacity scenarios.

requirements.requirement: Win at dawn with at least ceil(0.6 x lanterns) lit (reason dawn_survived), score 50 + floor(fuel) per lit lantern + 50 per flame; otherwise lose (reason dawn); lighting everything does not end the night.
requirements.how: dawn_win, dawn_lose_threshold, all_lit_no_early_win, lose_dawn scenarios.

requirements.requirement: Benchmark: 1280x720, 200 wander shades, 100 fireflies, L1-L3 lit, no spawn/damage/pickup/decay/end; bench.json has the contract fields and passes avg_fps > 60, p1_low_fps > 30, load_ms < 10000 (on the machine named in bench.json).
requirements.how: scripts/bench.mjs run by me (`npm run bench`), file committed; the sim side of the scene is tested in tests/phase4.test.ts; the frame statistics follow the ticket's formulas (tests).

requirements.requirement: Soak: 10 nights in one process, seed 7 + i, random inputs; crashes = 0 and mem_end_mb < 1.2 x mem_start_mb.
requirements.how: the contract's soak_cmd is run now by this script, and the committed soak.json is checked too.

requirements.requirement: Leaderboard: name 3-12 characters, top 10 by score, ties keep the earlier one on top, survives restart, Leaderboard screen, --export-leaderboard writes {entries: [...]}.
requirements.how: the real launcher is run with --export-leaderboard on a 12-entry store with a tie; the rules are in tests/leaderboard.test.ts. The screens were exercised by hand in the browser pane (see docs/notes/phase-4-manual-checks.md).

requirements.requirement: Accessibility: rebindable keys with duplicate warning and restore defaults, subtitles / cues, reduce motion, UI font >= 18 px with a large-text option (x1.25).
requirements.how: settings and phase4 tests; index.html has the controls and the two font sizes. Font sizes at 1280x720 and the screens were measured by hand in a browser (manual checks file).

requirements.requirement: Packaging: README with a run block of at most 3 commands, requirements, settings, controls, tests, headless, bench, soak, a screenshot; CHANGELOG for all 4 phases; CREDITS; LICENSE.
